title: Sum Array
description: Write a function that returns the sum of all numbers in a list. For example, given [1, 2, 3, 4, 5] the function should return 15.
instructions: Complete the sum_array function so it adds up every number in the list and returns the total.
hints: You need a way to keep a running total as you go through the list.
Try a for loop — go through each number and add it to a total variable.
Start your total at 0 before the loop begins.
